item.title: Allergens (full list)
item.description: Allergens: 1. Gluten 2. Eggs 3. Fish 4. Peanuts 5. Crustaceans 6. Milk 7. Soy 8. Sesame 9. Nuts 10. Celery 11. Mustard 12. Lupine 13. Sulphur dioxide 14. Molluscs 15. Garlic

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Beef rissoles with oven-baked potato slices and vegetables, topped with chives. Served with cucumber salad and bravas sauce. Also available gluten free. (1+6+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Jamaican brown stew chicken, served with traditional rice and peas and topped with thyme. Served with a crisp Caribbean coleslaw. The dish is gluten free. (15) GREEN DISH: Dish Jamaican brown stew tofu, served with traditional rice and peas and topped with thyme. Served with a crisp Caribbean coleslaw. The dish is gluten free. (7+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Confit duck with creamy mashed potatoes, sauce and bitter salads tossed in a mustard vinaigrette. (6+11+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Confit mushrooms with creamy mashed potatoes, herb sauce and bitter salads tossed in a mustard vinaigrette. (6+11+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Bean cassoulet, a rustic French classic with pork collar, bacon and sausages, white beans and vegetables in stock, finished with crisp breadcrumbs. (1) GREEN DISH: Dish Bean cassoulet, a rustic French classic with root vegetables, white beans and vegetables in stock, finished with crisp breadcrumbs. (1)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Pork tenderloin casserole with pork tenderloin, bacon, gourmet sausage and vegetables, served over silky mashed potatoes and topped with parsley. Served with a crisp “grandma’s salad” with dressing on the side and pickled cucumber. The dish is gluten free. (6) GREEN DISH: Dish Soy protein casserole with smoked tofu and vegetables, served over silky mashed potatoes and topped with parsley. Served with a crisp “grandma’s salad” with dressing on the side and pickled cucumber. The dish is gluten free. (6+7)
